g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Order for applying for a long-term care grade for older
adults: from checking eligibility to the home visit
survey and grade criteria
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-10
Check eligibility first
People who can apply are those aged 65 or older,
or those under 65 who have a geriatric illness
specified by presidential decree, such as…
Choose the application method and
documents
The applicant or a representative may apply.
Know what the home visit survey
examines
After you apply, an NHIS employee visits your
residence to conduct a survey.
Read the grade criteria: score ranges
and the Grade Assessment Committee
The regional Long-Term Care Grade Assessment
Committee assesses the survey results and
deliberation materials, including the doctor's…
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
